name: Test of Lore
summary: At Talondeep Path, Horde seekers face the Test of Lore. Braug Dimspirit asks them to find and study a tome of dragon history before he tests what they remember.

sections.title: A Shift in the Trials
sections.body: After trials across Thousand Needles' salt flats and plateaus, Dorn Plainstalker's candidates travel north to Braug Dimspirit in the Stonetalon Mountains. He waits near the mouth of Talondeep Path. Braug counts those earlier trials as tests of body and faith. Yet the Horde also needs disciplined minds and knowledge of ancient history, not only skill against beasts.

sections.title: The Shadows of Dor'Danil
sections.body: Braug sends seekers through Talondeep Path into southern Ashenvale. Beneath the trees south of Splintertree Post lies Dor'Danil Barrow Den, a dangerous ruin haunted by fallen night elf druids and the creatures that slaughtered them. Deep in its lower chambers, a stone podium holds 'Legacy of the Aspects'. The rare manuscript tells of the ancient creation and corruption of the great Dragon Aspects.

sections.title: Study or Suffer
sections.body: Braug's trial asks you to learn the tome's teachings before you hand it over. He takes the book and tests your memory of the Titan-empowered protectors and the betrayal that gave birth to Deathwing. Fail, or guess poorly, and you are banished across Kalimdor to Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. Then you must journey back to Stonetalon in disgrace.

faq.answer: Braug Dimspirit is an elder tauren shaman near Talondeep Path's entrance in the Stonetalon Mountains. After Dorn Plainstalker's earlier trials, Braug tests whether Horde champions match martial strength with knowledge and intellect.

faq.q: Where is the book Legacy of the Aspects located?
faq.answer: 'Legacy of the Aspects' rests inside Dor'Danil Barrow Den in southern Ashenvale, almost directly south of Splintertree Post. Deep beneath the barrows, it lies on a stone podium atop a central platform.

faq.q: What lurks inside Dor'Danil Barrow Den?
faq.answer: Dor'Danil Barrow Den was once a sanctuary for night elf druids. Restless spirits of the dead druids and the lethal creatures that butchered them haunt its hollows, making the ruin dangerous to cross.

faq.q: Why does Braug make me read the book before turning it in?
aliases: what happens if i fail the question
faq.answer: Braug takes the book when you return and tests your memory. He expects you to study it first, for he measures what you know as well as whether you can retrieve the volume.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into the broader trial series?
aliases: what comes before test of lore
faq.answer: This trial follows the Test of Faith that Dorn Plainstalker began at the Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles. Dorn tested your nerve and survival against deadly odds. Braug tests your knowledge of lore and history.

faq.q: What is the subject matter of the Legacy of the Aspects?
faq.answer: 'Legacy of the Aspects' tells how the Titans empowered the five great Dragon Aspects to safeguard Azeroth. It also tells of Neltharion the Earth-Warder's fall and his change into the destroyer known as Deathwing.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face a trial meant to prepare you for Kalimdor's deep history and Ashenvale's perilous elven ruins. Ignorance can leave you overcome there.
As a druid, you encounter the tragedy of night elf kin slain and corrupted in Dor'Danil Barrow Den. They once slept there in communion with the Emerald Dream.
